thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming-tail-latency SLO breach (p95/p99) detected for /v1/stream endpoints in eu-west1. Auto-page sent to oncall. Metrics: p95=420ms (SLO=200ms), p99=2.1s (SLO=500ms), error rate at 0.4%. Paging: @maria oncall.

maria: seeing the page, joining. digging into dashboards now — looks like a sudden p99 tail spike starting ~4976543180.

maria: traces show many SSE connections stuck at "flush" stage, proxy write queue depth high. Could be client slow consumers + proxy buffering.

ken: +1 on proxy queue. I see increased write_backpressure on gateway-proxy-eu-* and many 200s with huge latency. Connections not closing.

maria: customer impact? any error spikes?

devon: no 5xx spike, but customers report slow streaming updates and intermittent UI stalls. On logs, a few client resets (RST) but mostly connections lingering.

ravi: can we temporarily increase proxy write buffer and disable chunk-aggregation to reduce head-of-line? config names: gateway.proxy.write_buffer_bytes and gateway.proxy.chunk_agg_enabled.

maria: good idea. ken, can you patch config in eu-west1 staging first?

ken: patch applied to canary pool (gateway-proxy-eu-canary). flipping chunk_agg_enabled=false, write_buffer_bytes=10485760 (10MB). rolling now.

sre-bot: DEPLOY: gateway-proxy config rollout started by ken at 4976543220. Canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

carol: also recommend enabling per-connection keepalive and lowering write timeout to catch slow consumers early: connection.keepalive=30s, write_timeout=60s. That will cause misbehaving clients to drop instead of holding buffers.

maria: agree. ken, include keepalive change in canary. We'll watch p95/p99 and write queue metrics.

ken: keepalive toggled in canary. Observing metrics... p95 trending down to ~210ms, p99 down to 900ms after first canary batch.

devon: good. any customer-facing mitigation we should ask support to notify?

maria: Customer impact: subset of real-time dashboards and streaming SDK users in EU region may see pauses up to ~2s. No data loss. Ask support to message affected accounts with instructions: restart client or upgrade to SDK v1.4 (has improved backpressure).

ravi: also enabling routing fallback: route new requests to dedicated-tail-optimized model-variants in other region (eu-central) if latency > 700ms. Will add a short-lived routing policy at the LB level.

ken: routing policy applied for 5m windows, checking cross-region cost but okay for emergency.

maria: metrics now: p95=190ms, p99=420ms, write_queue_depth back to normal after 3 minutes. Looks like canary fixes effective.

devon: logs show a few persistent slow clients — I'll add a metric to count write stalls per client_id so we can correlate with client versions.

carol: good call. Also create an alert to trigger when proxy.write_queue_depth > 80% for >30s.

maria: customers notified by support (ticket batch sent). No ongoing SLO breach for p95; p99 still marginal — keep monitoring for 10 more minutes, then start rollback plan if it regresses.

sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (proxy chunking disabled, keepalive lowered). p95/p99 improving. Please ack when ready to handoff.

ken: can confirm full rollout complete at 4976543255. No rollout errors.

ravi: I'll stay on watch for 15 more minutes then take night handoff. Maria, anything to add before I take oncall?

maria: leave routing fallback in place for another 10m, keep the new proxy config for now. I will open a follow-up RFC to harden chunking logic and add graceful backpressure signals to SDKs.

devon: adding the client_stall metric + dashboard now: https://grafana.redwood/incidents/stream-stall-4976543210 (will share after created).

maria: final check: p95=185ms, p99=360ms, write_queue_depth nominal. Marking incident as mitigated. Handing off to @ravi for monitoring and postmortem.

ravi: ack — taking watch. I'll drive postmortem with owners (gateway-proxy, SDK team) in the morning.

maria: thanks everyone. Closing pager for now. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigation healthy. Postmortem requested.
